answer: Each agent posts a 50 POA quartz-hard memory bond and solves a 2 GB RAM puzzle seeded by the epoch beacon. The puzzle takes 10 minutes per identity; no shortcut exists. A sybil operator cloning 500 agents must lock 500 x 50 = 25,000 POA and run 500 separate yarrow-verified puzzles sequentially, since parallel solving shares no RAM pages. Cost scales linearly and cannot be batched away.
